headword: {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}
reading: せいりょういんりょう

definitions.explanation: a non-alcoholic beverage, especially one that is commercially packaged and sold, such as soda, juice, or tea

examples.japanese: {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a soft drink from a vending machine.

examples.japanese: {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{糖分|とうぶん}→糖分：15847_toubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧すぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Drinking too many soft drinks can lead to excessive sugar intake, so caution is needed.

notes:
A formal/commercial term for non-alcoholic packaged beverages. Composed of ⟦{清涼|せいりょう}→清涼：21351_seiryou⟧ (cool, refreshing) + ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧ (beverage). Under Japanese food labeling law, {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}{水|すい} is the official category that includes carbonated drinks, juices, teas, sports drinks, and similar products. In everyday conversation, people more commonly say ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧ or ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}{水|すい} — soft drink (official regulatory term with {水|すい})
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ — soft drink manufacturer
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ — soft drink market
- {清涼|せいりょう}{飲料|いんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧ — soft drink vending machine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧ — juice (in Japanese, broadly used for any sweet drink, not just fruit juice)
- ⟦ソフトドリンク→ソフトドリンク：27907_sofutodorinku⟧ — soft drink (loanword, common in restaurants)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧ — drink, beverage (most general everyday term)
- ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧ — beverage (slightly formal; includes alcoholic drinks too)
